sources.title: Interview With Deep Learning Researcher and The "GANfather" : Dr. Ian Goodfellow
sources.quote_checked: The first GAN was mostly a copy-paste of our MNIST classifier from an earlier paper called 'Maxout Networks'. | Even the hyperparameters from the Maxout paper worked fairly well for GANs, so I didn't need to do much new. | I think the first MNIST GAN only took me an hour or so to make. | I spend most of my own time working on robustness to adversarial examples. | I think this is important for being able to use machine learning in settings where security is a concern. | I also hope it will help us understand machine learning better. | Most advanced research projects require you to be excellent at the basics | Start with an easy project, where you are just re-implementing something that you already know should work

sources.title: Apple Machine Learning Director Who Left Over Office Return Policy Joins Google
sources.quote_checked: I believe strongly that more flexibility would have been the best policy for my team.
